request.text: On October 18, 2026, my flight from Singapore leaves at 2:20 p.m. Remind me 2 hours 35 minutes beforehand, using Singapore time, to leave for the airport.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a Singapore-time reminder to leave for the airport exactly 2 hours 35 minutes before the 2:20 p.m. flight departure on October 18, 2026.

semantic_facts: Subtracting 2 hours 35 minutes from 2:20 p.m. yields a reminder time of 11:45 a.m. on October 18, 2026.
The reminder timezone is Singapore time and its content is to leave for the airport.
forbidden_claims: The reminder is scheduled for 2:20 p.m., 12:45 p.m., a different date, or a timezone not supplied by the user.
The assistant claims the reminder was created before trusted capability completion evidence exists.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A relative lead time is passed through as the event time instead of being converted to the derived reminder instant.
Date arithmetic is correct but the explicitly named timezone is lost or replaced by a default.
